description: Default capability set for the Bifrost main window. Bifrost keeps the JS-side surface minimal: file I/O, process spawning, and Sandboxie / browser orchestration happen in Rust commands. The JS-callable surfaces granted are: `shell:allow-open` (external URLs like GitHub release pages open in the host browser), the trio of window read+resize permissions (`core:window:allow-inner-size`, `core:window:allow-scale-factor`, `core:window:allow-set-size`) used by the Settings roster-layout picker to snap the window width to fit 2 or 3 pilot cards, the `updater:default` set (check / download / install — signed-binary only; see `docs/RELEASING.md` for key-gen), and `process:allow-restart` so the updater can relaunch Bifrost after the new installer has run. The previous `core:webview:allow-set-webview-zoom` is gone — Settings › UI scale writes a `--text-scale` CSS variable instead. Everything else routes through our own tauri::commands.
